svg.title: Whole-body systems explorer with enlarged anatomy details
svg.desc: Original educational vector schematic. The main figure is a transparent front-view atlas: the person’s right is on the viewer’s left. Independent head and neck, reproductive, pregnancy, and blood-cell insets are separately labelled and are not all parts of one simultaneous anatomy. Organs, cell sizes, depth and routes are simplified; cutaways represent tissues distributed through the body. The main pelvic symbol is a locator only. Not for diagnosis, procedures or anatomical measurement.

g.aria-label: Spinal cord ending in the upper lumbar region, with cauda equina roots below
Mouth and oral cavity
Esophagus posterior to trachea, passing through diaphragm to stomach
Thyroid gland
Lungs: three lobes on the right, two on the left with cardiac notch
Thymus in the upper anterior mediastinum; representative adult remnant
Heart, obliquely placed between the lungs
Diaphragm, higher right dome beneath right lung
Kidneys against the back abdominal wall; right kidney lower than left
Ureters descending from the renal pelvis to the urinary bladder
Adrenal glands above the kidneys: right pyramidal and left crescent-shaped
Pancreas behind the stomach, with its head in the curve of the duodenum
Stomach with high fundus and descending greater curvature
Spleen at the left upper abdomen, lateral and posterior to the stomach
Liver, large right lobe under the right dome of the diaphragm
Gallbladder on the underside of the liver and bile duct
Duodenum and irregular overlapping jejunal and ileal loops
Large intestine with ascending, transverse, descending and sigmoid colon, rectum and appendix
